data.long_meaning: Elizabeth means 'God's oath of abundance.' The name is derived from the Hebrew words 'El' (God) and 'Bethes' (oath). In the New Testament, Elizabeth is the name of John the Baptist's mother. This name carries a rich history and symbolism, evoking images of faith, fertility, and divine promise. The name Lizabeth carries the meaning “God's Oath of Abundance” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Lizabeth usually hope their child will grow to embody god's oath of abundance and live with faith, good character and purpose.
